_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-11-12 'yeah start' (one of every type by the 19th): the SOS family (old remote qst09 UC Navy SOS and qst10 Freestar SOS), on MB104a's rescue shape (played 11-04)
_note: SOS: one survivor in an escape pod, his distress call the radio line on approach. MB104a's four steps: open the pod, check on him aboard, fly him to a city, see him off.
THE PLAYER'S PART: answering a call nobody else did, and the flight with a frightened man aboard.
The old SOS pair were UC Navy and Freestar; this is the base, and a UC or Freestar caller is a cheap variant (a different voice, a different city). No faction named aloud.
The pod model is MB104a's drifting cargo module as a stand-in; an escape pod mesh is his or Kim's pick.

place._second: New Atlantis, so the two rescues do not land in the same city.

prose.name: Rescue: Escape Pod over <Planet>
prose.briefing: An escape pod is broadcasting over <Planet>, one survivor aboard and his air running low. He needs picking up and taking somewhere safe.
prose.card: Escape pod beacon over <Planet>, one survivor, air running low. Pick him up and get him somewhere safe.

broadcast: This is an escape pod, one aboard, and I've got air for maybe a day. If anyone's out there, I'm the little light that isn't moving. Please don't fly past.
_speech: Young, frightened, holding it together by talking. Liam (ElevenLabs, unused in any Delve) as a stand-in; his ear decides.

beats._model: MB104a's drifting cargo module as the pod, a stand-in.
beats.name: Escape Pod

message.title: Escape Pod
message.text: The pod's seal hisses open. He's out and across into your airlock before you've finished docking.

person.name: Dane Whitlow
hellos: Still breathing. That's the main thing, isn't it?
I keep listening for the alarm. It's only habit now.

_bio.from: an engineer on a freighter that lost its reactor (his lines)
_bio.why_there: the last one out, in a pod that went the wrong way (his lines)
_bio.wants: to find out who else made it (his lines)

greeting: When the ship went, everyone else got to the other pods first. I was the last one out, and mine went the wrong way. Where are we headed?

exchanges.prompt: Somewhere safe. Sit down and breathe.
reply: That I can do. Wake me if anything on this ship starts beeping.
The reactor went. We had about a minute, and most of us used it well.

beats.journal: An escape pod over <Planet> was broadcasting with one survivor and a day of air. I took him aboard and flew him to <SecondPlace>.
greeting: This is me. The first thing I'm doing is finding out who else made it.

reply: So do I. Whatever happens, I owe you a drink I can't afford yet.
